# ============================================================
# main component for ESP32 firmware builds.
#
# Source files are assembled from three places:
#   1. app_main.c  (shim that calls into wink runtime + app callbacks)
#   2. Auto-scanned App sources + samples/common helpers
#      (generated by tools/esp32/generate_app_sources.py at configure time
#      into app_sources.cmake)
#   3. Codegen outputs (device_tree.[ch] + app_support.c), produced at
#      build time by tools/codegen/app_codegen.py from wink-app.json.
#
# P1 (2026-07-05): device_tree.c/h were deleted from the samples tree;
# they only exist as generated artefacts now. ESP-IDF builds must run
# codegen just like the host build does, otherwise #include "device_tree.h"
# in app_callbacks.c fails with "No such file or directory".
#
# IMPORTANT: IDF invokes component CMakeLists.txt in script mode (via
# component_get_requirements.cmake) BEFORE the real configure pass, only
# to extract the REQUIRES list. In script mode commands like
# add_custom_command / find_package are NOT available and must appear
# AFTER idf_component_register() �?they are only reached during the real
# configure pass. See comment in targets/esp32/CMakeLists.txt for full
# rationale.
# ============================================================
if(NOT DEFINED WINK_APP)
    set(WINK_APP "devkitc_smoke" CACHE STRING "Samples app name to build")
endif()

if(DEFINED ENV{WINK_APP_DIR} AND NOT DEFINED WINK_APP_DIR)
    set(WINK_APP_DIR $ENV{WINK_APP_DIR})
endif()

# configure 阶段自动�?Python 生成器，生成 app_sources.cmake（App + samples/common 源文件扫描）
# 注意：用 COMPONENT_DIR 而非 CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR——ESP-IDF �?build 目录处理组件依赖时后者会�?
# IDF 组件 CMakeLists 会跑两次（script-mode + real configure）；两次都需�?app_sources.cmake
# 存在（下�?include() 之前）。execute_process �?script mode 亦可用（�?PS1 版本靠此运行）�?
# find_package �?script mode 有可能不可用，故�?CMAKE_BUILD_EARLY_EXPANSION 门控并回退�?"python"�?
if(CMAKE_BUILD_EARLY_EXPANSION)
    # Script-mode pass：不�?find_package，直接用 PATH 上的 python（IDF 激活环境保�?py3 可用）�?
    set(_WINK_GEN_PY "python")
else()
    find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
    set(_WINK_GEN_PY "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}")
endif()

# 定位 Python 生成器脚本：优先 WINK_SDK_PATH（CMake -D 或环境变量），否则回退�?in-tree 布局�?
if(NOT DEFINED WINK_SDK_PATH AND DEFINED ENV{WINK_SDK_PATH})
    set(WINK_SDK_PATH "$ENV{WINK_SDK_PATH}")
endif()
if(DEFINED WINK_SDK_PATH)
    set(_WINK_GEN_SCRIPT "${WINK_SDK_PATH}/tools/esp32/generate_app_sources.py")
else()
    set(_WINK_GEN_SCRIPT "${COMPONENT_DIR}/../../wink-tools/tools/esp32/generate_app_sources.py")
endif()

if(DEFINED WINK_APP_DIR)
    set(_WINK_GEN_APP_ARGS --app-dir "${WINK_APP_DIR}")
else()
    set(_WINK_GEN_APP_ARGS --app-name "${WINK_APP}")
endif()

execute_process(
    COMMAND "${_WINK_GEN_PY}" "${_WINK_GEN_SCRIPT}"
            --esp32-firmware-dir "${COMPONENT_DIR}/.."
            ${_WINK_GEN_APP_ARGS}
    WORKING_DIRECTORY "${COMPONENT_DIR}/.."
    RESULT_VARIABLE GEN_SCRIPT_RESULT
)

if(NOT GEN_SCRIPT_RESULT EQUAL 0)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "generate_app_sources.py failed with code ${GEN_SCRIPT_RESULT}")
endif()

# 引入自动生成的源文件列表（设 WINK_APP_DIR / WINK_APP_SOURCES / WINK_APP_COMMON_INCLUDE_DIR�?
include(${COMPONENT_DIR}/app_sources.cmake)

# Codegen output directory. idf_component_register requires INCLUDE_DIRS
# to exist at script time; pre-create it (same pattern as targets/esp32/CMakeLists.txt
# uses for WINK_CONFIG_DIR). Generated headers are written here during build.
set(GEN_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${GEN_DIR})

# Check if this is an Arduino app (contains .ino files)
set(IS_ARDUINO_APP FALSE)
foreach(src ${WINK_APP_SOURCES})
    if(src MATCHES "\\.ino$")
        set(IS_ARDUINO_APP TRUE)
    endif()
endforeach()

set(APP_REQUIRES driver esp32)
if(IS_ARDUINO_APP)
    list(APPEND APP_REQUIRES arduino)
endif()

idf_component_register(
    SRCS
        "app_main.c"
        ${WINK_APP_SOURCES}       # �?自动扫描得到（app_callbacks.c + samples/common helpers�?
        # Codegen outputs (device_tree.c) are added after
        # register() via target_sources() �?see below. They cannot be listed
        # here because the OUTPUT variables (GEN_DEVICE_TREE_C etc.) are only
        # defined after register() when add_custom_command is available.
    INCLUDE_DIRS
        "."
        ${WINK_APP_DIR}           # �?App 头文件目�?
        ${GEN_DIR}                # �?codegen 生成�?device_tree.h 所在目�?
        ${WINK_APP_COMMON_INCLUDE_DIR}  # �?samples/common/include
    REQUIRES ${APP_REQUIRES}
    WHOLE_ARCHIVE
)

# Set language CXX for .ino files
foreach(src ${WINK_APP_SOURCES})
    if(src MATCHES "\\.ino$")
        set_source_files_properties(${src} PROPERTIES LANGUAGE CXX)
        if(MSVC)
            set_source_files_properties(${src} PROPERTIES COMPILE_FLAGS "/TP")
        else()
            set_source_files_properties(${src} PROPERTIES COMPILE_FLAGS "-x c++")
        endif()
    endif()
endforeach()

# ── Codegen (wink-app.json �?device_tree.[ch]) ────────
# Everything below runs ONLY during the real configure pass (script mode
# stops at idf_component_register). Mirrors the host/wasm integration:
# on every build, if wink-app.json / templates / driver plugins changed,
# app_codegen.py regenerates the four artefacts under ${GEN_DIR}.
# Note: find_package(Python3) already called above for generate_app_sources.py;
# CMake caches the result so the second call is a no-op.
find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)

if(NOT DEFINED WINK_CODEGEN_ROOT)
    set(WINK_CODEGEN_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../wink-tools/tools/codegen")
endif()
set(WINK_CODEGEN_TOOL "${WINK_CODEGEN_ROOT}/app_codegen.py")
set(WINK_APP_JSON     "${WINK_APP_DIR}/wink-app.json")

if(EXISTS "${WINK_APP_JSON}")
    set(GEN_DEVICE_TREE_H ${GEN_DIR}/device_tree.h)
    set(GEN_DEVICE_TREE_C ${GEN_DIR}/device_tree.c)
    set(GEN_APP_OPTIONS   ${GEN_DIR}/app_options.cmake)  # also applied by targets/esp32 for motor/encoder

    file(GLOB WINK_CODEGEN_TEMPLATES ${WINK_CODEGEN_ROOT}/templates/*.j2)
    file(GLOB WINK_CODEGEN_DRIVERS   ${WINK_CODEGEN_ROOT}/drivers/*.py)

    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT ${GEN_DEVICE_TREE_H} ${GEN_DEVICE_TREE_C}
               ${GEN_APP_OPTIONS}
        COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${WINK_CODEGEN_TOOL}
                --config ${WINK_APP_JSON}
                --out-dir ${GEN_DIR}
        DEPENDS ${WINK_APP_JSON} ${WINK_CODEGEN_TOOL}
                ${WINK_CODEGEN_TEMPLATES} ${WINK_CODEGEN_DRIVERS}
        COMMENT "Generating ${WINK_APP} device tree from wink-app.json (esp32)"
        VERBATIM
    )

    # Add the generated .c files to this component's sources.
    target_sources(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE
        ${GEN_DEVICE_TREE_C}
    )

    # Ensure compilation of this component waits until codegen has produced
    # device_tree.h and friends.
    add_custom_target(wink_app_codegen DEPENDS
        ${GEN_DEVICE_TREE_H} ${GEN_DEVICE_TREE_C})
    add_dependencies(${COMPONENT_LIB} wink_app_codegen)
endif()

# Windows GCC 默认�?GBK 解析源文件，中文 UTF-8 注释会乱码报�?
# 强制指定源文件编码为 UTF-8，解决中文注释编译错�?
target_compile_options(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE
    -finput-charset=UTF-8
    -fexec-charset=UTF-8
)

# S10 sim_echo: on devkitc_smoke, arm the ultrasonic echo simulator so the
# HC-SR04 path is exercised end-to-end (TRIG ISR �?mock task drives ECHO
# �?RMT captures pulse �?cm computed) WITHOUT requiring a physical
# reflector.  WINK_CFG_SIM_ECHO gates the #include and the start() call
# in app_callbacks.c; the runtime TU wink_sim_ultrasonic_echo.c compiles
# unconditionally into the pal component (gated by WINK_STRICT_NONBLOCKING)
# and degrades gracefully to WINK_ERR_UNSUPPORTED on host/wasm.
# Other apps (which may use real ultrasonic hardware with a reflector)
# don't set this define and therefore don't arm the simulator.
if(WINK_APP STREQUAL "devkitc_smoke")
    target_compile_definitions(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE WINK_CFG_SIM_ECHO=1)
endif()
